user.title: SmartThings Find
user.description: Choose an authentication method. **Samsung Account** is recommended because it can automatically issue a new web session from locally stored renewable authorization when the web cookie expires. The manually copied Cookie header remains available for compatibility.

account.title: Samsung Account sign-in
account.description:
1. [Open the Samsung Account sign-in page]({login_url})
2. Complete Samsung sign-in and any second-factor prompt.
3. When the browser reaches an `ms-app://...` address or reports that it cannot open the app, copy the **complete address**.
4. Paste that address below.

Your password and second factor are handled by Samsung and are not provided to this integration. Renewable authorization is kept in private files under Home Assistant `.storage` and is used only to renew tokens and the web session.

**Mode**
- Passive: read the cached server location (lower battery impact)
- Active: request a location update first (fresher, higher battery impact)

cookie.title: Cookie header compatibility mode
cookie.description:
1) Sign in at {stf_url}
2) DevTools (F12) → Network
3) Select `chkLogin.do`
4) Copy the complete `Cookie:` request header and paste it below.

This mode still requires a newly copied cookie when Samsung fully revokes the server session. Samsung Account authentication is recommended for unattended operation.

**Mode**
- Passive: read the cached server location
- Active: request a location update first

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Use the new sign-in link again or verify the Cookie header.
error.no_devices: No devices were found for this account.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Samsung authentication or SmartThings Find. Try again later.

init.title: SmartThings Find options
init.description:
Current authentication method: `{auth_method}`

Samsung Account mode automatically rebuilds an expired web session. Cookie mode allows a replacement Cookie header; leave it empty to retain the current value.

Keepalive calls use slight timing jitter around the configured interval. The default is 180 seconds.

**Mode**
- Passive: read the cached server location
- Active: request a location update first

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. The Cookie header is expired or invalid.
error.no_devices: No devices were found for this account.
